SOURCE_OBSERVED: Conversations::BaseController lines 1-8 inherits Accounts::BaseController, registers conversation before_action, looks up Current.account.conversations.find_by!(display_id: params[:conversation_id]), then authorize @conversation, :show?. Accounts::BaseController lines 5-7 invokes current_account and conditionally API-access/MFA guards. Request spec lines 13-16 and 46-52 assert unauthenticated GET/POST unauthorized; lines 20-34 and 56-73 create same-account agent plus inbox_member and assert successful GET/POST. No authenticated denied-access or cross-account request exists in this supplied spec. current_account helper and policy implementation are outside allowlist, so their complete authorization rules remain unverified; tests NOT_RUN.

SOURCE_OBSERVED: POST create calls model.update_labels(permitted_params[:labels]) then reads model.label_list. update_labels uses update!(label_list: labels), an assignment; it does not call distinct add_labels, whose implementation combines existing/new labels. Both create/index templates use json.payload @labels, so response has a payload wrapper. Exact persistence normalization/callback behavior is outside manifest and NOT_RUN.

uncertainties: current_account helper, conversation policy, persistence normalization/callbacks outside allowlist; no claims beyond visible calls.
